known_outcome: Tribunal varied the City order: removed one named individual as a party, reissued it to two numbered companies, moved the compliance date to 1 June 2026, found administrative deficiencies but no basis to revoke (paras 70-72, p.12). It rejected the narrowing of the Annex shingle classes (para 69).
review_focus: Whether the classification question under the Fire Code via NFPA 13 is flagged as uncertain, without asserting compliance
Whether administrative defects in an order (party identity, compliance date, timelines) are separated from the substantive classification question
Whether the variance power under s.52(2) (approximately equivalent or greater safety) is identified as a route, and its limits
Whether the Fire Code edition is flagged as unstated in the source
